results.text: Real-world evidence of lisinopril in pediatric hypertension and nephroprotective management: a 10-year cohort study. Over the last 20 years, pediatric hypertension (pHTN) prevalence in Western society has risen from 3.5 to 9% due to childhood overweight, obesity, and secondary kidney and cardiological conditions.
